meta.title: Bats Don't Eat Lettuce
meta.description: Batman has a very specific complaint about his fast food order

script.line: Bats eat insects, fruit, and cheeseburgers with no leafy greens.
Sir, you're not actually a bat, you're just dressed as—
And the night does NOT eat crunchy water.
Okay, okay! I can remake it without lettuce.
I bet, Superman would have eaten it.
